subject: Session token containment + log audit — ETA and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acme-logistics.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Follow up on pen-test finding — session token reuse (Finding #3)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for sending the pen-test report last week. The auditor flagged Finding #3 ("session token reuse / missing revocation path") as high-impact for our SOC 2 scope. They need:

- A short remediation summary for the finding (what you changed and why)
- Evidence that tokens are now being rejected after revocation (sample logs)
- Keystore rotation proof and a timeline for full rollout
- Any config changes (session TTLs, refresh token policies) and when those take effect

Can you confirm the planned remediation approach and provide an ETA for the evidence package? Our auditor would like artifacts delivered by 2027-06-25 if possible.

Appreciate a concise list of deliverables and owners so I can pass it to Bright Assurance.

Tom Sanders
Security Lead — Acme Logistics
--
Tom.Sanders@acme-logistics.com
(555) 212-0199

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow up on pen-test finding — session token reuse (Finding #3)

Tom — thanks for the note and the auditor deadline. Below is our remediation plan and a short ETA table. Ill coordinate handoff artifacts to the Bright Assurance folder once items are ready.

Summary of remediation (high level):
- Implemented immediate revocation checks in the session service so revoked access tokens are rejected (hotfix deployed to prod small fleet).
- Added a keystore rotation workflow (initial rotation completed; rolling rotation scheduled).
- Hardened refresh-token issuance and shortened default idle TTLs for sessions created before rotation.
- Added structured session rejection logs (new ES mapping + sample events) to make auditor queries straightforward.

Owners + ETA (high level):
- Keystore rotation finalization: karthik_iyer — ETA 2027-06-20 (rolling finish, see manifest)
- Log schema + sample logs export: marissa_cole — ETA 2027-06-18 (will include grepable samples and Kibana links)
- Token revocation verification (test harness + proofs): irene_choi — ETA 2027-06-17
- Config change propagation (TTL and refresh policy): naomi_feldman (ops coordination) — staged rollout complete by 2027-06-19

Planned deliverables for Bright Assurance:
1) Remediation summary PDF (what we changed, reference to commit IDs) — session_token_mitigation_plan.pdf
2) Keystore rotation manifest (CSV with rotation timestamps, keys rotated) — keystore_rotation_manifest.csv
3) Sample log exports showing rejected tokens and correlation IDs — included in logs.zip (we will place in Drive folder)
4) Short runbook describing the verification steps auditors can run (commands + Kibana saved query)

Attachments: session_token_mitigation_plan.pdf (draft), log_schema_changes.diff, keystore_rotation_manifest.csv

If the auditor needs any live access to Kibana, we can provide a read-only link and a short walkthrough. Ill post the Drive folder link and HubSpot ticket once the artifacts are uploaded.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Security Partnerships — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow up on pen-test finding — session token reuse (Finding #3)

Tom / team — quick technical update on the keystore and rollout plan.

- We completed the first rotation wave (control plane + 2 availability zones) on 2027-06-17. No service impact observed.
- Remaining waves (3 zones) scheduled 2027-06-19 to 2027-06-20. Final manifest will include per-instance timestamps and signatures.
- The revocation controller has been instrumented to emit structured events with fields: action, token_id, revocation_reason, request_id. Marissa will export samples.
- For auditors: were including a small test harness (curl + JWT example) that demonstrates revocation in < 1s. Ill attach the harness file to the drive.

ETA notes: keystore rotation finalization still on track for 2027-06-20; however, sample export size may push the artifacts delivery window to 2027-06-21 morning PST (too large to zip earlier). Well prioritize a minimal sample set for the auditor by 2027-06-18.

Links: Jira SEC-1127 has the per-instance tasks; Drive folder (will be populated): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-session-mitigation

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acme-logistics.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Audior <soc2-auditor@brightassurance.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow up on pen-test finding — session token reuse (Finding #3)

Thanks Naomi / Karthik — that plan looks good and the incremental deliverable schedule works for Bright Assurance. Two quick asks before you upload: 

1) Please include the Kibana saved-query IDs and a short README (commands the auditor can run).
2) Can you also map this specific finding to the CAIQ question set (which control(s) changed)? A one-paragraph mapping table will suffice.

Once you upload the artifacts to the Drive folder, please reply-all so I can confirm receipt and close the open item with our auditor.

Appreciate the coordination.

Tom
Security Lead — Acme Logistics
